excerpt.zh: 曾几何时，该文明的天空短暂地被流星所照亮，紧接着就陷入了长久的黑暗。此后他们试图冲出天际以寻求答案，并在第一次太空征程中发现了一座休眠中（并且早已被遗弃）的量子弹弓单阵列。
excerpt.en: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) Quantum Catapult Single Array.

texts.zh: 曾几何时，该文明的天空短暂地被流星所照亮，紧接着就陷入了长久的黑暗。此后他们试图冲出天际以寻求答案，并在第一次太空征程中发现了一座休眠中（并且早已被遗弃）的量子弹弓单阵列。
texts.en: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) Quantum Catapult Single Array.

sections.zh:
自上古以来我们的人民就能时不时地看到夜空被无数流星所照亮，但至今我们的科学家还是不能解释这种现象。随着我们开始探索星系，我们最终获得了追踪这些扰动现象原因的必要装备——一个被我们的工程师称为量子弹弓单阵列的古老构造。

尽管陷入休眠，部分被毁还遭到遗弃，我们依旧坚信其能回复往日的荣光。如果按照我们的预期工作，它将成为通往星系各处的星门。
sections.en:
Since time immemorial our people have seen the night sky occasionally lit up by innumerable shooting stars, and even until recently our scientists have been unable to explain the phenomenon. As we have started exploring the galaxy we have finally gotten the equipment necessary to track down the cause of these disturbances - an old structure our engineers have called a Quantum Catapult Single Array.

Though dormant, partly in ruins, and abandoned, we believe it can be restored to former glory. If it works as envisioned, it will be our gateway to the rest of the galaxy.

sections.zh:
自我们鸿蒙初开之时便能时不时地看到天空被无数的流星所照亮，并完全无法理解是什么可能造成了这种奇怪的现象。随着我们终于脱出母星的桎梏，我们成功地获得了追踪这些扰动现象原因的必要工具——一个量子弹弓单阵列。

尽管陷入休眠，部分被毁还遭到遗弃，我们依旧坚信其能回复往日的荣光。如果按照我们的预期工作，它将成为通往星系各处的星门。
sections.en:
Since the earliest moments of our consciousness we have occasionally seen the sky lit up by innumerable shooting stars, and been unable to come to terms with what might cause this weird phenomenon. As we have freed ourselves from the shackles of our homeworld, we have managed to obtain the tools necessary to track down the cause of this disturbance - a Quantum Catapult Single Array.

Though dormant, partly in ruins, and abandoned, we believe it can be restored to former glory. If it works as envisioned, it will be our gateway to the rest of the galaxy.

title.zh: 量子弹弓单阵列已获得

texts.zh: 我们终于获得了量子弹弓单阵列所在的恒星系及其周边区域。现在我们可以送工程师过去以开始修复工程，这样就能让这个休眠的结构重获新生。
texts.en: We have finally secured the system and region around the broken Quantum Catapult Single Array. Now at last, we can send engineers in to start the repair work necessary to bring this dormant structure back to life.

texts.zh:
在蓝图和图示之中我们恢复了一份奇怪的文档：

这是来自量子建筑师的个人文件

鸿蒙之初，我们居于黑暗。上帝说：“要有黑暗”，于是世界充满了黑暗。当我们最初的祖先获得了知觉之光，我们就想在天空中搜寻生命的迹象和意义，但我们的头顶只有无际的黑暗。随着我们建立了文明，我们的思想扫过黑夜中的每一片阴影，我们在建立第一座城市的地方辛勤劳作，经常测试它们的地基。

数千年后，我突然莽撞地向“上”看了一眼。当其他人还面朝大地而劳作时，我的思绪却向天空打开。我建造了电路和钢铁的神殿，用我的智慧之光制作了我自己的工具。通过完善二极管和电容器的迷宫，我将我的意识传播到整个宇宙，感知笼罩在我们世界的黑暗之外的一切事物。

因为我能感受到其他人感受不到的东西：我们在宇宙并不孤独。通过玻璃般的黑暗，我能感受到数以千计的其他星球。我能感知到不可能。在我们无尽的黑夜之外是燎原般的万千星点。
texts.en:
Among blueprints and schematics, we recovered a strange document:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

In the beginning, we dwelled in darkness. Our gods said, 'let there be dark,' and there was. When our first ancestors gained the spark of sentience, we searched the heavens for signs of life or meaning, but all above us was darkness. As we built our civilization, our minds scanned for shadows in the night. We toiled in the places where we built our first cities, always testing their foundations.

Thousands of years later, I had the temerity to look *up*.While others labored with their gaze downcast, my mind opened up to the heavens. Building a temple of circuitry and steel, I formed my own tools, empowered by the light of my intellect. Perfecting a labyrinth of diodes and capacitors, I cast my consciousness through the cosmos, perceiving something beyond the dark skies that shrouded our world.

For I could sense what others could not: We were not alone in the universe. As though through a glass darkly, I could detect thousands of other worlds. I could sense the impossible. Beyond the night burned a thousand points of light.

texts.zh:
尽管我们的探险队还在筛选能够解码该巨型结构的建造计划的数据，他们已经发现了另一个看起来像是宗教文本的摘录：

来自量子建筑师的个人文件

我吐露真相，而我的人民却回以混乱。
我们每个人都在自己思想和情感的迷雾中麻木劳作。我们试探性地对他人伸出手，但我们中有太多人是孤独的。我们的神在黑暗中创造了世界，我们被告知说我们才是神的造物的中心。

就因为我胆敢梦想天外的世界，我的愿景就被他人认为是谎言。我们当中的其他人问：怎么才能证明这些梦？我们怎么能相信我们不能证明的事？作为回应，我将那些还愿意听我的人引到自己的实验室。这些最聪明的头脑可以感知到我所能感知到的：夜幕之外的其他星球。

而最黑暗的头脑却报之以其他的回应，他们捏造新的论点，紧握致命的武器。那些危险的头脑吟唱寓言，说我们的星球会陷入动荡，因为我们不再是神的宠儿。然而我还是知道真相：创造之光是一幅巨大的帷幕。查宇宙之秘，我被欣喜的浪潮所裹挟，渐渐失去了自己的身份。
texts.en:
While our expedition keeps sifting through the data to decode the megastructure's plans, they have found another excerpt of what looks like a religous text:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

I spoke the truth, and my people answered with chaos.
Each of us labors in our own fog of thoughts and emotions. We tentatively reach out to others, yet so many of us are alone. Our gods crafted the world from darkness, we are told, and we were allegedly the centerpiece of their creation.

Because I dared to dream of worlds beyond, I was told my vision was a lie. Who among us, others asked, could confirm these dreams? How can we believe, they said, what we cannot prove? And in response, I led those who would listen to my laboratory. The brightest minds could perceive a reflection of what I experienced: other worlds beyond the veil of night.

The darkest minds crafted other responses, formed new arguments, clutched deadly weapons. Dangerous minds sang that our world would be in turmoil, for we were no longer the favored spawn of the gods. Yet I knew the truth: Creation's illumination was a vast tapestry. Contemplating the majesty of the cosmos, I was swept away in tides of rapture, losing my identity.

texts.zh:
更多类弥赛亚的文本被恢复：

来自量子建筑师的个人文件

我不断地被无边无垠的宇宙所折磨和诱惑，开始考虑去遥远的世界并亲自体验。生活在被无尽黑夜包裹的世界中，其他的头脑做着美梦，而我寻求于他们进行交流。在黑暗之外有光明指引着我，光明诱惑着我，给予了我无限的启示。因此我把我的思想广播到遥远而未知的世界……

天上如是，地上亦然。我对天空的愿景带给了我喜悦，在地上，我同样找到了给我同样的解脱的幸福的人。我与另一个科学家坠入爱河，那是一位有远见的人，用其他的办法在群星中寻求我所感知到的世界。

我们并不只是分享各自所见。我们立誓成为对方终生的伴侣。随着工作的进展，我们依偎在每一个漫漫长夜。我的伴侣梦到了星舰的设计图，在蜡制设计版中刻出原始的太阳能航空器。我不断用电路修修补补，努力将我的思想和无限融合起来。我的冒险越是深入，我内心的欣喜就越是充盈。多么美妙啊！永无止境的欢愉！
texts.en:
More of the quasi messianic figure's writings have been recovered:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

Tormented and tantalized by a boundless cosmos, I contemplated the means to travel to distant worlds and experience them firsthand. Enshrouded beyond the endless night, other minds dreamed, and I sought communion with them. Beyond a great darkness, a great Light led me on, offering me temptations and endless revelations. And thus I cast my mind out further into the unknown...

As above, so below. My visions of the heavens brought me joy, but down below, I found someone who brought me the same liberation of happiness. I fell in love with another scientist, a visionary who spoke of other ways to seek the stars I had sensed in my reveries.

We did more than share a vision. We pledged ourselves as partners for life. And as our work progressed, we stayed up later each night. My partner dreamed designs for starships, etching crude solar-powered spacecraft on their wax design board. I tinkered with circuitry, straining to unify my mind with infinity. The farther I ventured, the more my rapture grew. Such bliss! The ecstasy of endless eternity!

texts.zh:
来自量子建筑师的个人文件，其身份为宇宙制船师的伴侣

我的伴侣十分耐心而我却有些莽撞。我的挚爱拥有科学和逻辑的智慧而我也有着驰骋的心际。随着我们漫漫长夜中愈行愈远，我徒劳地将自己的意识广播到虚空。我忽视了睡眠，忽视了饥饿，最终也忽视了我的挚爱。我们在宇宙中追寻梦想的同时，内心却开始出现了鸿沟。

我的挚爱为这种现象创造了一个词：量子纠缠。我的身体还在这儿，但思想却驰骛天外，竭力地探寻欣喜和与永恒的交流。我的伴侣跟我说其他话，但我丝毫听不进去。“吾爱”，我的伴侣说，“回到我的身边”，但我却只能听到恒星的回声。

很快就到了测试我伴侣的太阳能星舰的时候。我志愿驾驶这架飞船。当我第一次掌舵并开始处女航之时，我将梦到通往遥远海岸的航线，我的身还在原处，心已神游天外。

我的挚爱渐渐平静下来，我会赐予我的挚爱无限，通往永恒，来吾道夫先路。我会给予我的挚爱万千世界之梦。
texts.en:
From the personal files of the Quantum Architect, partner of the Cosmic Shipwright

My partner was patient, and I was reckless. My Beloved had science and logic, and I had my psychic reveries. Longer and longer into the night, I vainly attempted to cast my consciousness into the void. I neglected sleep. I neglected food. I neglected My Beloved. As we pursued our dreams of venturing into the cosmos, a gulf grew between us.

My Beloved found words for our phenomenon: quantum entanglement. My body was here, but my mind was eons away, desperately seeking ecstasy and a communion with eternity. My partner told me other words, but I would not listen. 'My Love,' they said, 'come back to me,' but I could only hear the echoes of the stars.

Soon, the time will come to test my partner's solar starship. I have volunteered sit at the controls. As I sit at the helm of its first test flight, I will dream of a course to distant shores, my mind *here* and my body *there*.

My Beloved has grown quiet, but I will gift them with infinity, blazing a trail to eternity. I will offer them the dreams of a thousand worlds.

texts.zh:
来自宇宙制船师的个人文件，其身份为量子建筑师的遗孀

我们的第一艘星舰一年前就消失了。我们至今不知道之前到底发生了什么。我的伴侣，量子建筑师，他只留下了遗产和谜团。我们所能做的最深入的推测也不过是我的挚爱最终成为了宇宙中的一员。在他坐上控制面板之前开始处女航，他与无限融合在了一起，被对天空的狂喜和遐想所吞没。我们的测试船再也没有回来。

现在我只能用手头上粗糙的工具劳作，将我已经一片狼藉的工作和生活重拾起来。我更多的太阳能舰船开始了前往永夜的旅途。我开始着手安装更好的引擎，原型引擎能够让我们的舰船穿越超空间。在某些夜晚，我梦想着有一种技术可以将我们送往未知的星系，就像我失去的伴侣的思想和灵魂那样。

我向光明伸出手臂，拒绝向黑暗屈服。我坐在我的挚爱的实验室中，就像现在那样阅读他们的日志并写下自己的日志。有时候当一切陷入至暗，我尝试着把我的思想广播向宇宙。这是无限的信标。
texts.en:
From the personal files of the Cosmic Shipwright, widow of the Quantum Architect

Our first starship vanished a year ago. We still do not know precisely what happened. My partner, the Quantum Architect, has left behind a legacy and a mystery. As far as we can derive, My Love finally became one with the cosmos. Sitting at the controls aboard our first test flight, they merged with infinity, overwhelmed by rapturous psychic contemplation of the heavens. Our test ship never returned.

Now I labor with my own crude tools, left to reforge my work and my life from the wreckage. More of my solar starships have begun their journeys into the Great Night. I have begun work on better engines, prototypes that can propel our vessels through hyperspace. And on some nights, I dream of a technology that can leap for the stars like the mind and soul of my lost partner, launching us into the unknown.

As I reach for the light, I refuse to succumb to the darkness. I sit in My Love's laboratory, just as I am now, reading their journals and writing my own. And sometimes, when all is darkest, I attempt to cast my own mind across the cosmos. Infinity beckons.

texts.zh:
随着我们终于找到了该结构建造计划的缺失文件，我们还原了最后的文本：

来自宇宙制船师的文件，其身份为量子建筑师的遗孀

我们探寻了许多方法以实现我的挚爱的创新，也就是他们的量子创造。我不知道我们是否可以沿着这条看似莽撞的道路，以量子建筑师的设计为蓝本，以缓慢的步伐抵达群星。我寻求能跨越超空间的浪潮，思考着能将我们带到遥远彼岸的流向。

我的舰船沿着缓慢的路线前进，在深夜中我读着我的挚爱的日志，努力理解其中的数学表达式和相关机理。当我的思想触及无限时，我意识到我的挚爱还在那儿。他引导了先路，我必须跟着前行。

通过失去我却反而获得了灵感。我们曾开始制造过一个伟大的机械，它能够推动我们的舰船跨越星系，就如同我的挚爱跨入无限那样。当我离开时，我谦逊地要求这台宇宙设备以及其迭代更新产物应该纳入量子建筑师的个人日志。当其他人读到这篇日志时，毫无疑问我的灵魂已经飞往远方。我会找到在无垠的宇宙中和我的挚爱团聚的道路。因为我知道我们将共同居住在永恒中，梦想并漂流在万千星点之中。
texts.en:
As we finally found the missing pieces for the structure plans, we also recovered one last text:

From the files of the Cosmic Shipwright, widow of the Quantum Architect

We have searched for ways to employ My Love's innovations, their quantum creations. I am left wondering if we can take that same reckless path, empowered by the Quantum Architect's designs, but I reach for the stars at a slower pace. I search for a wave to ride through hyperspace, contemplating a current that will take us to distant shores.

My ships take the slow route, but late at night, I read My Love's journals, struggling to tame their mathematics and machinations. As my mind reaches out towards eternity, I know in my heart that My Love is still out there. They blazed a trail towards heaven, and I must follow.

Through loss, I have found inspiration. We have begun work on a grand machine that will propel our ships across the galaxy, just as My Beloved leapt into infinity. And someday, I will do what they have done. When I am gone, I humbly request that this cosmic device and all its iterations should include the personal logs of the Quantum Architect. Doubtless by the time others read this, my soul will have taken taken flight. I will have found a way to join My Beloved out there in the vast expanse. For I know that we will dwell in eternity together, dreaming and drifting through a thousand points of light.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了一个损毁的巨型结构残骸。该构造显然亟需修复，同时我们也在其数据库中发现了饱含着有关异星生物的见解的宝贵财富。尽管我们还在决定是否要重建这一远古科技的造物，我们的考古学家有机会去发掘并取回这宇宙设备起源的线索。它的其中一个发明者，“量子建筑师”相关的日志似乎格外有价值。恢复这些文件对我们解密遗留给我们科技的远古种族的文化和历史必然有着莫大的帮助。
texts.en: We have found the wreckage of a ruined megastructure. The construct is obviously in desperate need of repairs, and we've found a wealth of xenological insights in its databanks. While we're deciding whether to rebuild this ancient technology, our archaeologists have an opportunity to extract and recover clues to the origin of this cosmic device. A series of logs from one of the inventors, the 'Quantum Architect,' seems especially promising. Recovering files should help us decipher the culture and history of the ancient race that left us this tech.

sections.zh: 我们已经找到了一个损毁的巨型结构残骸。该构造显然亟需修复，同时我们也在其数据库中发现了饱含着有关异星生物的见解的宝贵财富。尽管我们还在决定是否要重建这一远古科技的造物，我们的考古学家有机会去发掘并取回这宇宙设备起源的线索。它的其中一个发明者，“量子建筑师”相关的日志似乎格外有价值。恢复这些文件对我们解密遗留给我们科技的远古种族的文化和历史必然有着莫大的帮助。
sections.en: We have found the wreckage of a ruined megastructure. The construct is obviously in desperate need of repairs, and we've found a wealth of xenological insights in its databanks. While we're deciding whether to rebuild this ancient technology, our archaeologists have an opportunity to extract and recover clues to the origin of this cosmic device. A series of logs from one of the inventors, the 'Quantum Architect,' seems especially promising. Recovering files should help us decipher the culture and history of the ancient race that left us this tech.
